0.original: The Dotharli youth is looking for someone to protect her.

25.original: Speak with the Dotharli youth and slay any enemies that appear.

27.original: Speak with the Dotharli youth and slay any enemies that appear.

48.original: Hello there, traveler. I would appreciate your help, should you have the time.

49.original: However, I would prefer to discuss it somewhere free from prying eyes. Meet me in front of the Dusk Throne.

50.original: Thank you for coming. I wish to go to meet with Nhaama. But the road to her is fraught with peril. As such, I need someone to protect me.

51.original: It was only a few weeks ago that both my mother and father were taken from me by the heartless Oronir.

52.original: Their deaths made me realize that I must commune with the Dusk Mother. I shall pray that she strike down those who pretend they are the children of Azim, and that she continue to nurture the Dotharl.

53.original: Nhaama resides in the House of the Crooked Coin to the north. I have heard many tales recently of pilgrims being slain by the monsters that lie in wait along the trail.

54.original: The same must not happen to me. Please, be on your guard. Rendezvous with me further to the north.

55.original: The Dusk Mother awaits. Let us make haste.

56.original: It seems the tales I heard were true. Dispatch them swiftly!

57.original: Thank you. Let us resume the climb.

58.original: More beasts. There is no other way to reach Nhaama. We must not falter!

59.original: We are close now. So very close...

60.original: Thank you for seeing me here safely. There is one last thing I would request of you.

61.original: Deliver this to a girl in Dotharl Khaa named Maral.

62.original: Now, please leave me to be alone with the Dusk Mother.

63.original: Is there something you wish to say to me?

65.original: So she has gone to be one with the Dusk Mother. I have no doubt it is what she wanted, but that knowledge does naught to alleviate the pain in my heart.

66.original: The House contains a crystal─a sliver of Nhaama's essence. Those who wish to rejoin with the Dusk Mother throw themselves down into the cavern there. This breaks the cycle of reincarnation.

67.original: The Dusk Mother has always been at the center of my friend's life. The same was true of her previous incarnations.

68.original: To think, if she had been killed together with her family, her spirit could have moved into the child my sister is about to birth...

69.original: Forget what I just said. I did not mean it. We should take solace in the knowledge that she is finally at peace.

70.original: The envelope her letter came in also contained what seems to be your compensation for helping her. Please accept it as a token of her gratitude.
